Portfolio Project 01 — CIP Drainage Rehabilitation

Multi-Phase Highway Drainage Rehabilitation — Stormwater Analysis & Cost Control

Westgate Corridor, Houston, TX · 2.4-mile arterial corridor · Sep 2024 – Jan 2025 · Design-Bid-Build / CIP
View project details +

Multi-phase rehabilitation of an aging storm drainage system along a 2.4-mile arterial corridor in Houston. Scope included a NOAA Atlas 14 storm-frequency analysis, delineation of 6 contributing sub-basins across 640 acres, replacement of undersized reinforced-concrete storm sewer, upsizing of 3 box culvert crossings for the 100-year event, and rehabilitation of 42 drainage structures. Budget-variance tracking and change-order coordination drove a 12% improvement in cost control against the original CIP estimate.

Scope of Work

  • NOAA Atlas 14 (Vol. 11) 10-yr and 100-yr, 24-hr storm-frequency analysis
  • Delineation of 6 sub-basins across 640 contributing acres
  • 8,200 LF of 24"–48" RCP storm sewer replacement
  • 3 box culvert crossings upsized for the 100-yr design storm
  • Inlet and manhole rehabilitation across 42 structures
  • Erosion control and outfall stabilization at 4 discharge points
  • Pre-construction coordination with utility owners & municipal reviewers

Portfolio Project 02 — Type IA Commercial

5-Story Commercial Building — Structural & MEP Cost Estimate and CPM Schedule

5-story, 95,200 SF Type IA commercial office building with 19,040 SF basement parking. Cast-in-place concrete columns and flat slabs, structural steel roof framing, and an aluminum curtain wall envelope. Full MEP scope including VAV HVAC, NFPA 13 fire sprinkler, and 2000A electrical service. Estimate built on RSMeans 2024 with a Houston location factor of 0.92, delivered Design-Bid-Build.

Scope of Work

  • 42 drilled piers (30" dia. × 35' deep) with grade beams
  • Cast-in-place concrete columns & flat slabs — 5 floor cycles
  • 85 tons structural steel roof framing + metal decking
  • 28,800 SF aluminum curtain wall + 14,400 SF metal panels
  • 200-ton chiller, 3 AHUs, 85 VAV boxes (HVAC)
  • 114,240 SF NFPA 13 wet sprinkler coverage
  • 2000A switchgear, 250 kW generator, fire alarm
  • 82 plumbing fixtures — domestic water, sanitary, storm
